steps.what: Read the actual current animal-care plan and last care entry using native animal and date filters
inputs: Current animal-care plan and actual prior entries maintained by animal-care staff
outputs: Verified animal-specific care context in the animal-care register

steps.what: Observe the actual animal and enclosure conditions and identify concerns requiring the responsible animal-care professional
Confirm actual immediate animal-care readiness within the current care plan and the naturalist's real competence and authority
inputs: Actual current animal and enclosure conditions
Existing care plan and real competence
outputs: Actual current decision to proceed with specified routine care or stop for professional help

steps.what: Provide the actual routine care for the park program animal under the existing care plan
inputs: Real animal, enclosure and care materials
outputs: Actual completed routine care and observed response

steps.what: Write and check the actual care entry after care, using native reuse of the existing animal identifier
outputs: Completed actual care entry in the animal-care register

steps.what: Save the actual care entry in the existing animal-care register

tasks.design: Use native animal and date views in the animal-care register, {OPS_SYSTEM}, with the actual plan in {DOCS}. The naturalist observes and cares for the animal, then writes the real care entry; only navigation and exact identifier reuse change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care staff repeatedly find the same animal record and retype its identifier.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record context can preserve the identifier and expose the actual latest entry.
tasks.still_hard: Animal welfare, immediate handling conditions and actual care require trained human attention.
tasks.human_edge: Notice abnormal behaviour and stop when professional animal-care help is needed.

ambition.what: No increased animal-care workload or autonomous care is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual care records and staff permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native animal-record views and identifier reuse can reduce clerical handling without performing or prescribing animal care.

assumptions: Representative routine-care episode under an actual current care plan with an actual required care entry. Responsible animal-care staff produce plans and prior entries during their existing work; reading and verification remain in s1. No new plan production or veterinary assessment is supplied for free.

s2 counts actual observation. s3 is the current physical-care readiness decision, not approval of authored paperwork. a1 applies only to the specified care under actual current conditions; a changed animal condition, care plan or handling situation invalidates it. No medication or veterinary treatment is generated or automated.

s5 separately counts actual care recording after completed care. It does not infer completion from a schedule. The existing animal identifier is verified in s1; missing or mismatched identifiers require manual resolution. No clean observation feed or transcription is assumed.

Use native views and field context first. Existing functions have no new gain. If no care entry is actually required, remove it and re-estimate rather than inventing an administrative baseline. Any real professional referral or message is distinct actual work with its real authority.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 10*0.10+9*0.10=1.9; upkeep 0.5 leaves net 1.4. Retained s1-s5 labour is 97.1 already counted. Same-system save is minimum integer share 1, fully retained and ungated, with no self-approval or saving.
unknowns: Actual required care records and existing native views
Naturalist's real care competence and escalation process
research_questions: Observe one actual routine-care episode and inspect the real pre-care lookup and post-care entry.

already_counted.description: Actual care-plan reading, observation, readiness, physical care and post-care entry remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain native animal views and identifier context beyond existing care-record checks.

approvals.approved_version: The specified routine care under the actual current animal condition and care plan; any condition or plan change requires a fresh readiness decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires repeated care-record navigation and identifier entry. If native tools already remove both, there is no new saving or new configuration upkeep. Observation and actual care remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual route status and verified scientific, historical and natural-feature references using native route filters
inputs: Current route information from park operations staff
outputs: Verified route and feature context in the existing park information system

steps.what: Conduct the actual field trip, point out scientific, historic and natural features and respond to the group and actual route conditions
inputs: Actual visitor group and site conditions
outputs: Actual guided field trip and spoken interpretation

tasks.design: Use native route filters in the park information system, {OPS_SYSTEM}, and verified feature material in {DOCS}. The naturalist conducts the actual trip and adapts interpretation to visitors and site conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current route and feature information is repeatedly located before a trip.
tasks.enabler_now: Native route views can bring existing references together without producing the trip itself.
tasks.still_hard: Group needs, actual terrain, changing conditions and engaging interpretation require a person on site.
tasks.human_edge: Connect what visitors actually notice with accurate scientific and historical explanation.

ambition.what: No additional trip capacity is inferred from a small navigation reduction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native route-information views can reduce lookup effort while guided trips and live interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Representative delivery of an existing interpretive route, not original program design. Park operations staff produce current route information and interpretive staff produce existing materials during ordinary work; their work remains unchanged and focal reading remains in s1.

Only repeated navigation changes; full reading and checking actual route conditions remain. Existing route views provide no new saving. No free sensor feed, automatic route-safety judgement or generated historical fact is assumed.

No separate trip report, attendance write or notice is established for this delivery episode. If actual registration, attendance, incident entry or completion record is required, split its real writing and any send from the trip and place completion after actual delivery before estimating that episode. Do not add a report merely to create a saving.
There is no termly program setup charged to every trip and no automated visitor communication. Actual travel and group management are retained in s2.
Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 10*0.20=2; upkeep 0.5 leaves net 1.5. Retained s1-s2 labour is 98 already counted.
unknowns: Whether current route views already exist
Actual trip registration, attendance and incident record requirements
research_questions: Observe an existing-route field trip and identify actual lookup and record requirements separately from live delivery.

already_counted.description: Actual route reading and complete live field-trip delivery remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: Maintain route-filter configuration beyond ordinary pre-trip reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound reduces repeated route navigation while retaining reading and the whole trip. If the existing park view already supplies this context, no new saving or upkeep is incurred. No reduction is claimed for live delivery.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide park visitor information and service

steps.what: Listen to the visitor's actual request, needs or complaint and clarify what assistance is required
inputs: Actual visitor and question or concern

steps.what: Find and read the current park regulations, area information and service references using native topic filters
inputs: Actual current park information maintained by responsible park staff
outputs: Relevant original information and unresolved matters in the park information system

steps.what: Provide the actual visitor service: explain park regulations and area information, answer needs and complaints, and clarify limits or the responsible service
outputs: Actual spoken visitor assistance and clarification

tasks.design: Use native topic filters in the park information system, {OPS_SYSTEM}, with current material in {DOCS}. The naturalist clarifies the actual need and provides the real visitor response; no source lookup is treated as a resolved complaint.
tasks.previous_blocker: The naturalist repeatedly navigates park information while assisting visitors.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic and service views can narrow the relevant existing material.
tasks.still_hard: Visitor needs, distress, accessibility concerns and complaints require responsive human service.
tasks.human_edge: Explain information in a way the actual visitor can use and recognise unresolved concerns.

ambition.what: Use existing accurate material to help a visitor whose question spans several park services.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native topic views can assist visitor information retrieval without replacing live service or resolving complaints automatically.

assumptions: Representative face-to-face information and service episode. Responsible park staff produce current regulations and information during existing work; focal reading remains in s2. s1 counts the actual question clarification, with no free transcript or machine-ready intent feed.
The reduction is navigation only, not interpretation or source verification. Missing, outdated or uncertain information requires actual manual investigation. Existing topic filters have no new gain.

No case entry is established for an ordinary spoken query. For an actual complaint requiring a case record, escalation or written reply, split the real record writing, authority and send out of the conversation before estimating that episode. Do not silently apply this routine episode to formal complaints or invent a post-conversation report.
There is no automatic refund, booking, regulatory determination or external message. Real service actions beyond spoken assistance require their actual steps and authority.
Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.30=6; upkeep 1 leaves net 5. Retained s1-s3 labour is 94 already counted.
unknowns: Existing topic filters and information currency
research_questions: Observe actual visitor requests and identify when a spoken response becomes a recorded complaint or service action.

already_counted.description: Actual need clarification, original information reading and live visitor assistance remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain topic views beyond existing park-information checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires substantial repeated navigation during actual information requests. If current park views already retrieve the material, no new reduction or configuration upkeep is incurred. Live visitor assistance is fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and present illustrated park talks

steps.what: Read actual park feature sources and inspect available illustrations; verify image rights, facts, captions and exact references
inputs: Existing feature sources and illustration collection maintained by park interpretive staff
outputs: Verified source and illustration references with actual permissions

steps.what: Choose the actual interpretive message, talk structure and illustrations for the audience; record exact image and caption selections
outputs: Human talk outline and explicit image-caption mapping

steps.what: Insert the exact selected illustrations, captions and source references into the talk draft
inputs: Verified illustrations and explicit mapping from s1-s2
outputs: Illustrated draft with exact captions and references

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual illustrated lecture and interpretive talk, using native slide layouts in the existing document and presentation editor
Save the completed talk in its existing presentation workspace
Present the actual illustrated lecture and interpretive talk about park features and respond to the audience

tasks.design: In the existing document and presentation editor, {DOCS}, insert only human-selected illustrations and exact captions, then use native layouts. The naturalist writes and checks the interpretation and gives the actual talk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact illustrations and captions are recopied and slides repeatedly laid out during genuine talk preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit image mappings and native layouts can handle assembly without generating interpretive facts.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting an accurate message, matching the audience and presenting engagingly require the naturalist.
tasks.human_edge: Connect park features to audience interests while explaining the limits of available knowledge.

ambition.what: Prepare an audience-specific version of an existing illustrated talk where actual preparation is needed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to check actual illustration rights and editor access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact image-caption insertion and native presentation layouts can assist illustrated-talk preparation while interpretive writing and live delivery remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode that genuinely includes preparing a talk and presenting it. Do not charge this preparation to every repeat delivery; measure actual preparation frequency before a role estimate. Existing source and image collections are produced by interpretive staff in ordinary work; s1 counts actual factual and permission verification.

s1-s2 supply every image identifier, exact caption, source and mapping used by s3. Missing images, uncertain rights or unavailable references return to manual work. No free curated new illustration feed or generated historical fact is assumed.
Use native editor insertion and layouts first. Existing automated assembly yields no new gain. s4 reduces layout effort only; actual interpretive prose, accessibility and factual checks remain human.

s5 is an ordinary same-system save with no self-approval and no saving. No publication or external file send is hidden in it. s6 is actual live presentation, fully retained. If a real public upload or written issue is required, add its actual authority and separate action.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15+24*0.20=19.8; upkeep 3 leaves net 16.8. Retained s1,s2,s4,s6 labour is 79.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: How often a talk is genuinely prepared versus repeated
Existing native illustration insertion and layout functions
research_questions: Inspect one actual talk-preparation episode and distinguish original interpretation from exact illustration assembly and live delivery.

already_counted.description: Source and rights verification, message selection, talk writing and checking, and live presentation remain in s1,s2,s4,s6.

incremental.description: Maintain illustration mappings and reusable layouts beyond ordinary talk preparation checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires observed manual illustration assembly plus native layout savings. If exact image insertion already handles s3, only 4.8 layout points remain eligible; 3 upkeep leaves 1.8. Repeat delivery without genuine preparation needs its own lower estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Park operations staff maintaining actual route information
Animal-care professionals owning real care plans
Interpretive staff maintaining verified sources and illustrations
role.ambitious_version: A park naturalist who spends less effort assembling existing information while retaining animal care, field interpretation and direct visitor relationships.
